datasets.verbatim: As shown in Table 1, the HRSIs data were sourced from Google Earth images (https://earth.google.com/)

datasets.name: Terrain data (DEM)
datasets.verbatim: and the terrain data were sourced from DEM data (https://search.asf.alaska.edu/) generated by the Advanced Land Observing Satellite (ALOS) phased array L-band synthetic aperture radar (PALSAR).

datasets.name: Landslide sample dataset (1500 samples)
datasets.verbatim: In this study, the landslide dataset was constructed based on historical landslide data with field verification. ArcMap 10.2 software was utilized for the identification and interpretation of landslides within the imagery.

methods.name: CTHNet (CNN–Transformer Hybrid Network)
methods.summary: CTHNet is an encoder-decoder architecture for landslide identification. The encoder uses a VGG-16 variant CNN module for local feature extraction and a multi-scale lightweight transformer (MLT) module for global context information. The decoder uses skip connections and upsampling to fuse features and recover spatial details.
methods.source: Juan Li, Jin Zhang, Yongyong Fu
methods.verbatim: Following this idea, we proposed a CNN–transformer hybrid model (CTHNet) using HRSIs for loess landslide identification.

availability.author_statement: The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not linked or referenced, and the custom CTHNet code is not provided in a repository or persistent link.
